items.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>The anodic reaction of oxygen evolution reaction (OER), an important point for electrolysis, however, remains the obstacle due to its complicated reaction at electrochemical interfaces. Iridium oxide (IrO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>) is the only currently known 5d transition metal oxide possessing admirable OER activity. Tremendous efforts have been carried out to enhance the activity of iridium oxides. Unfortunately there lies a gap in understanding what factors responsible for the activity in doped IrO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> or the novel crystal structure. Based on two metallic pyrochlores (Bi<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>Ir<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>O<jats:sub>7</jats:sub> and Pb<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>Ir<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>O<jats:sub>6.5</jats:sub>) and IrO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub>. It has been found that there exists a strong correlation between the specific OER activity and IrO<jats:sub>6</jats:sub> coordination geometry. The more distortion in IrO<jats:sub>6</jats:sub> geometry ascends the activity of Ir sites, and generates activity order of Pb-Ir > IrO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> > Bi-Ir. Our characterizations reveal that distorted IrO<jats:sub>6</jats:sub> in Pb-Ir induces a disappearance of J = 1/2 subbands in valence band, while Bi-Ir and IrO<jats:sub>2</jats:sub> resist this nature probe. The performed DFT calculations indicated the distortion in IrO<jats:sub>6</jats:sub> geometry can optimize binding strength between Ir-5d and O-2p due to broader d band width. Based on this insight, enhancement in OER activity is obtained by effects that change IrO<jats:sub>6</jats:sub> octahedral geometry through doping or utilizing structural manipulation with nature of distorted octahedral coordination.</jats:p>
title: OER activity manipulated by IrO6 coordination geometry: an insight from pyrochlore iridates
